title: bardolier port add output
description: What `bardolier port add` declared, and on which host port. cli-spec.md §6 (Ports), §5.1.

extra_ports.description: Every extra port declared afterwards, sorted by name.

compose_regenerated.description: False when the regenerated compose file was byte-identical to the old one (§9).

degraded_roots.description: Present only when a configured root could not be read while this ran (phase 27) — allocation used its last known state instead of refusing.

offline_root.description: One unreadable root and how stale bardolier's last look at it is. This block is duplicated verbatim in new/clone/service-add/port-add; test/contracts.test.ts asserts the copies stay identical.

attached_extra_port.description: A declared extra port: the manifest's host port plus the caller's own name. cli-spec.md §5.1, §6 (Ports). Duplicated verbatim across status/port-add/port-remove/port-list; test/contracts.test.ts asserts the copies stay identical.
